products.title: Oteco Packing Units for Hydril GK, GKM & MSP Annular BOPs
products.descriptionShort: Oteco replacement packing units for Hydril GK, GKM and MSP annular blowout preventers, 7-1/16" to 21-1/4", 2,000 to 5,000 psi, in natural rubber, nitrile and neoprene — 24 part numbers. Authorised Oteco distributor, UAE stock.
products.descriptionLong:
Oteco moulds replacement annular packing units for Hydril GK, GKM and MSP blowout preventers in its own rubber plant in Houston, where it formulates and mixes the compounds. Each unit is functionally tested before it ships. The units cover screw-head, latch-head and helicopter-lift-head preventers from 7-1/16 in to 21-1/4 in bore.

Choosing a compound

  • Natural rubber (NR) — water-based mud, best low-temperature flexibility and the longest life where oil content is low.
  • Nitrile (NBR) — oil-based and synthetic-based mud and hydrocarbons.
  • Neoprene (CR) — mixed and low-aniline-point fluids where natural rubber swells.

Match the bore, the working pressure and the head type on the BOP nameplate; the size table lists the head types each unit fits.
